141864317.accepts_evidence: The funding page invites nonprofits to review the regional grant guidelines and start an online application; the FAQ says the portal is open all year and a late application rolls to the next deadline (https://www.td.com/us/en/about-us/funding-opportunities)
141864317.conflicts_with_return: Return says deadlines NONE; site lists four fixed deadlines a year. Otherwise consistent (501(c)(3), TD footprint, one grant per year, similar exclusions)
141864317.contact: General: TD.us-charitablegiving@td.com. Regional: NewEnglandCharitableGiving@td.com; NewYorkCharitableGiving@td.com (NY, southern CT, northern NJ); PANJCharitableGiving@td.com; MidSouthCharitableGiving@td.com (DE, VA, MD, DC, NC, SC); FloridaCharitableGiving@td.com
141864317.deadlines: Regional grants, 2027 funding calendar (funding period Nov 1, 2026 to Oct 31, 2027): Fri Nov 13, 2026; Fri Mar 12, 2027; Fri May 14, 2027; Fri Jul 30, 2027. Decisions about two months after each deadline. Capacity Building: twice a year, dates on its own calendar (not shown on pages read). Training Resource Fund: rolling, reviewed monthly
141864317.eligibility: 501(c)(3) nonprofits, public schools, or qualified state or local government entities with programs open to the public; must meet anti-discrimination policy. Capacity Building prefers operating budgets of $2 million or less and no more than $200,000 from TD in the past 12 months
141864317.geographic_limits: Programs must operate inside TD Bank's U.S. footprint (New England, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD, DC, VA, NC, SC, FL per the regional contact list); national or multi-region groups are considered only on a limited basis and should talk to a TD giving manager first
141864317.grant_range_stated: Regional grants: not stated. Capacity Building: $25,000 to $150,000. Nonprofit Training Resource Fund: up to $1,000
141864317.how_to_apply: Read the regional grants guidelines/FAQ, then apply online only through the CyberGrants portal (eligibility quiz first). One application form with board list, audit or 990, IRS letter, organization budget and project budget. One grant per organization in any twelve months; a declined project waits a year
141864317.name: TD Charitable Foundation
141864317.not_funded: Individuals; private foundations; political candidates, lobbying or advocacy groups; religious organizations; fraternal, labor, recreational or social groups; athletic teams and sporting events; research; capital campaigns or building requests; endowments or memorial campaigns; deficit reduction; galas, fundraising drives and annual appeals; conferences, trade shows, travel; programs outside the footprint
141864317.notes: Three separate programs with different rules (regional grants, Housing for Everyone, Capacity Building Fund including a training fund). The first FY2027 regional deadline is today, Nov 13, 2026; next is Mar 12, 2027. Capacity Building recipients cannot reapply for two years. The site lists two slightly different sets of regional email addresses. TD also runs a separate Community Sponsorship Program (not the Foundation) with its own calendar.
